package repository

import (
	"time"

	"github.com/example/ms-student-service/internal/domain"
)

// LearningActionLifecycleRepository owns the atomic answer/action/outbox boundary.
type LearningActionLifecycleRepository interface {
	CreateAnswer(
		ctx Context,
		answer domain.StudentTaskAnswer,
		maxAttempts *int,
		action domain.StudentLearningAction,
	) (domain.StudentTaskAnswer, domain.StudentLearningAction, error)
	EnsureActive(ctx Context, action domain.StudentLearningAction) (domain.StudentLearningAction, error)
	GetActiveByAnswer(ctx Context, answerID string) (domain.StudentLearningAction, error)
	ReopenAnswer(ctx Context, answer domain.StudentTaskAnswer, action domain.StudentLearningAction) (domain.StudentLearningAction, error)
	CloseAnswer(
		ctx Context,
		answer domain.StudentTaskAnswer,
		action domain.StudentLearningAction,
		event domain.IntegrationEvent,
	) error
}

// LearningActionReader resolves one student-owned action without exposing
// mutable answer state or objective outcome through the HTTP contract.
type LearningActionReader interface {
	GetByStudentAndID(ctx Context, studentID, learningActionID string) (domain.StudentLearningAction, error)
}

// PracticeLearningActionRepository owns the Practice-token binding lifecycle.
// It deliberately does not create a Course answer or emit a Course closure event.
type PracticeLearningActionRepository interface {
	ReservePracticeLearningAction(ctx Context, input domain.PracticeLearningActionReserve) (domain.PracticeLearningActionBinding, bool, error)
	GetPracticeLearningAction(ctx Context, studentID, taskInstanceID string) (domain.PracticeLearningActionBinding, error)
	OpenPracticeLearningAction(ctx Context, studentID, taskInstanceID, learningActionID string, now time.Time) (domain.PracticeLearningActionBinding, bool, error)
	CancelPracticeLearningAction(ctx Context, studentID, taskInstanceID, learningActionID, reason string, now time.Time) (domain.PracticeLearningActionBinding, bool, error)
}

// PracticeLearningActionEvidenceRepository closes only a pre-existing OPEN
// v2 Practice binding. It deliberately has no Course/outbox semantics.
type PracticeLearningActionEvidenceRepository interface {
	ApplyPracticeLearningActionEvidence(ctx Context, evidence domain.PracticeCompetencyEvidenceBundleV2, closedAt time.Time) (bool, error)
}

// OutboxClaim describes one bounded publication lease request.
type OutboxClaim struct {
	WorkerID    string
	Limit       int
	Now         time.Time
	LockedUntil time.Time
}

// Outbox stores durable student integration events until broker acknowledgement.
type Outbox interface {
	Claim(ctx Context, claim OutboxClaim) ([]domain.IntegrationEvent, error)
	MarkPublished(ctx Context, eventID, workerID string, publishedAt time.Time) error
	MarkFailed(ctx Context, eventID, workerID, message string, retryAt time.Time) error
}
